usedFor: Memberful tracks members, Dropbox stores files, and “When an order is completed” can run “Upload File to Dropbox”.

bestTemplate.name: “When an order is completed” in Memberful, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: The trigger carries order and member details, and the action saves a file from a public link into a folder.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” lets you add, replace or update an existing file, so set that choice deliberately.
